name: Muzzio
description: A brilliant inventor and professor at the Academy at High Paliano whose constructs spy on the city and who manipulates the board to gain the vice chancellorship.

timeline.summary: The Board of Senior Advisors rejects Muzzio's motion to become vice chancellor after Alendis retires and elects Tulando instead.
timeline.quote: To elect Professor Tulando vice chancellor once Alendis retires.

timeline.summary: Tulando and Grinaldi discuss rumors that Muzzio serves the Black Rose, sponsors Sydri and killed Daretti.
Muzzio, upset at losing the vice chancellor vote, summons his apprentice Irie to his workshop to accelerate his training.
timeline.quote: he had summoned for his apprentice, Irie.

timeline.summary: Muzzio reveals his hidden workshop containing an army of constructs and a scale model of Paliano, and Irie pretends to see it for the first time.
timeline.quote: The centerpiece of the room, surrounded by whirring noises of various machines and the iron army, was a scale model of Paliano

timeline.summary: Muzzio denies ever having killed anyone and reveals that his constructs record everything people say onto wax cylinders.
timeline.quote: Within each of the constructs is a series of needles that transcribes all that they hear onto wax cylinders

timeline.summary: Muzzio explains his grand design to mitigate human variables and says the vice chancellorship would have given him the autonomy for the next phase; Brago's death and seeming ascension made the board cautious.
timeline.quote: But the death of Brago and his seeming ascension, which I couldn't foresee, caused them to vote more cautiously.

timeline.summary: With the others gone, the board carries Muzzio's motion to become vice chancellor once Alendis becomes chancellor.
Grenzo tells Daretti the Academy is dead, Muzzio exiled and cogwork outlawed, and urges him to act like a hyena.
timeline.quote: Well, the academy is dead and Muzzio is exiled.

relations.note: Irie is Muzzio's apprentice and keeps up his workshop.
relations.quote: Muzzio had seen the potential in the boy and brought him on as his apprentice.

pages_say.description: A brilliant inventor and professor at the Academy at High Paliano whose constructs spy on the city and who manipulates the board to gain the vice chancellorship.
An apprentice and academic, now exiled, whom Fimarell dedicated himself to.
An academic whose artificial servants were replaced by exotic beasts used by Paliano's nobles.
